title: Eclipse Braid
summary: A one-handed print-in-place desk toy whose captive squared-crescent runner follows one fully visible braided figure-eight route through two separated alternating bridges, reverses travel orientation at the far lobe, and returns home by continued thumb motion.

interaction.motion: Guide the crescent continuously around the visible rail with the thumb in either direction.
interaction.reset: Continue around the same closed route; shaking is not required.
interaction.orientation_event: The route tangent reverses at the far lobe and returns to its home direction after one full circuit.

printing.orientation: frame flat on the build plate

limitations: Digitally validated geometry is not evidence of a successful physical print.
Friction, wear, comfort, and meditative feel require later physical evaluation.
Small moving gaps depend on printer calibration and material behaviour.
